generation_history.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: the provided balcony photograph is the sole edit target.
Asset type: unapproved residential window visual concept, photorealistic architectural photograph.
Edit the glazing only. Deliver exactly native 1536×1024 pixels, landscape 3:2, with precisely the original camera position, crop, perspective, lighting and room geometry.
Replace the existing outer balcony window assembly with ONE broad, uninterrupted, full-height clear FIXED GLASS main panel from the ceiling perimeter frame down to the floor frame. Remove the horizontal metal rail crossing the city view, its thin central vertical guard post, and the thin vertical mullion in the main glass field. There must be NO horizontal bar, transom, guardrail or mullion cutting the eye-level view anywhere across the main opening. Preserve the real architectural perimeter, existing overhead beam and side columns and foreground sliding-door jamb/threshold.
The only operable opening is a narrow full-height vent sash at the RIGHTMOST SIDE of the OUTER glazing immediately next to the right column. Show a subtle slim perimeter, a believable small handle and a slight ajar edge so the side vent reads operable; do not divide the main viewing panel. Main glass remains closed. Keep subtle glass edge reflections and slight interior reflections so it clearly reads as enclosed transparent fixed glazing, never a glass-free open drop.
Preserve exactly the fold-away tea ledge and its bracket, kettle, cup, chair and chair position, wall sconce, timber wall, curtains, stone floor and warm light. The real-looking Shanghai residential skyline and green park outside must remain unchanged in location, scale, buildings and character. No sea, ocean, waterfront, mountain, new landmark or outdoor scene replacement.
No text, logos, measurements, labels, watermark or approval markings. This is a visual concept only; do not represent engineering approval.

observations: Main field is one uninterrupted full-height fixed-glass concept with no central horizontal rail or vertical mullion.
Narrow rightmost operable sash is visibly ajar; its edge frame and handle are confined to the side.
Overhead perimeter, columns, foreground sliding-door jamb/threshold, tea ledge, kettle, cup, chair, curtains, light and stone floor remain visually consistent.
Glass edge reflections and enclosed perimeter remain visible.
Residential Shanghai-style buildings and park retained; no ocean introduced.
limitations: Generative edit retains the skyline character and layout but is not a pixel-exact restoration of every building detail.
